name: Admin Diagnostic NDA Download
description: Admin downloads the generated Acuerdo de Confidencialidad from the Documentos tab. 'Descargar' link → GET /api/diagnostics/:id/confidentiality/pdf/ (FileResponse, streams the saved PDF with placeholders filled from confidentiality_params). 'Borrador' link → GET /api/diagnostics/:id/confidentiality/draft-pdf/ (renders fresh with all placeholders forced to XXX-XXX-XXX and applies BORRADOR watermark). When no NDA exists, neither link is present and the section shows 'No generado' with 'Generar acuerdo' CTA.
